title: Angler Chicago Fishing Charters

services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Angler Charters offers Weekday and weekend 6-hour or 8-hour Chicago fishing charters that are available for 1-6 people. Angler Charters also offers Chicago sightseeing, special events, Navy Pier fireworks trips, and corporate charters. This is the perfect way to spend the day trolling for salmon & trout and enjoying the beautiful Chicago city scape off in the distance as we move around Lake Michigan in search of fish. All our Chicago fishing charters and cruising adventures are family friendly and serious anglers are welcome aboard too.
